sign: The old chapel sank here with the choir inside. On still nights they are still on the second verse.
drowned_cantor: Wystan: My choir sank with the chapel. I stayed up here to conduct. They're flat on the high notes, but they never stop.
drowned_cantor_intro: Wystan: You're off the beat. Let me correct you.
drowned_cantor_defeat: Wystan: Better. You can join them when you're ready.
